comparison.objective: Bimanually flex a build plate to release a printed part without kinking it; candidate commissions an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Distributed elastic bending and part capture differ from recessed tool engagement, controlled collar rotation, tightening, and cycle-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Requires part release into a bin and plate returned flat; candidate requires quantified impact behavior and post-lock stability.
comparison.reason: Force control is shared only generically; the tested mechanics and failure modes differ.
